shots.text: By then it had been dark for months. Crops failed. Solenne lived by torchlight on rationed bread.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Solenne under a black sky, lit by torches and the Heartstone's faint six-coloured pulse. A bread line in the square.

shots.text: I ruled by voice. I learned people by their footsteps.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Ysolde on her throne, blindfold of black and gold, Fennick's brass measuring rod across her knees. Heroes standing in the dim hall.

shots.text: Fennick wrote everything down. Which towers work where, and why. I'll read it to you, Spirewright. Badly.
shots.speaker: tamsin
shots.art_note: Tamsin at a war table under a lantern, reading from Fennick's battered notebook with his spectacles in her hand.

shots.text: The dark came from the Rift, and the further east we went, the thicker it got. East was where we were going.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A night road lit by a line of lanterns: the army, carts, towers glowing in six colours along the way, heading east.
